query: Consider the Agreement between SE_NDCA and PRE-QUAL PACKAGE; Does the document allow verbally conveyed information to be considered as Confidential Information?
gold: “Confidential Information” shall mean all information, regardless of the form in which it is communicated or maintained (whether oral, written, electronic or visual) and whether prepared by Company or otherwise, which is disclosed to Counterparty, regardless of whether such information is disclosed intentionally or inadvertently, before or after the execution of this Agreement, in connection with the Transaction and including all records, reports, analyses, notes, memoranda, documentation, knowledge, data, specifications, diagrams, statistics, systems or software, manuals, business plans, operational information or practices, processes (whether or not patented, patentable or reduced to practice), customer lists, concepts, ideas, policies, contractual arrangements with, and information about, the Company’s suppliers, distributors and customers, the existence of the discussions between the Parties concerning the Transaction, or other information that are based on, contain or reflect any such Confidential Information.
rag_answer:
Yes. Under Section 1 of the Agreement, “Confidential Information” includes all information “regardless of the form in which it is communicated or maintained (whether oral, written, electronic or visual).” Therefore, verbally conveyed information can be considered Confidential Information if it is disclosed in connection with the Transaction.

The Agreement also states that all information received from the Company is considered Confidential Information unless it is specifically designated as non-proprietary and non-confidential, subject to the stated exclusions.

judge.gold_summary: 金标结论为 Confidential Information 包括以口头形式传达或保存的信息，只要该信息与 Transaction 相关并披露给 Counterparty。
judge.answer_summary: 系统回答指出 Yes，并引用 Section 1 中 Confidential Information 包含 oral、written、electronic、visual 等形式，因此口头传达的信息在 Transaction 相关披露时可构成 Confidential Information。
judge.reason: 系统回答准确覆盖了金标的关键要点：口头信息可属于 Confidential Information，且与 Transaction 相关。额外补充内容不影响判定。
